ARABIC LANGUAGE — TERMLY EXAM #1 (TERM 1)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ARABIC LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How is the Arabic word صَبَاحُ الْخَيْرِ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. marhaban
   B. sabaahu l-khayr
   C. anaa bi-khayr
   D. as-salaamu ʿalaykum

2. Which Arabic word means "peace be upon you"? (1 mark)
   A. كَيْفَ حَالُكَ؟
   B. السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ
   C. شُكْرًا
   D. صَبَاحُ الْخَيْرِ

3. Which Arabic word means "thank you"? (1 mark)
   A. اسْمِي
   B. مَسَاءُ الْخَيْرِ
   C. شُكْرًا
   D. مَرْحَبًا

4. Which pair of words are two family members from the father's side and the mother's side? (1 mark)
   A. ab and umm
   B. ʿamm and khaal
   C. akh and ukht
   D. ibn and bint

5. Which Arabic sentence means "Who is this? (a boy or man)" (1 mark)
   A. عِنْدِي أَخٌ وَأُخْتٌ
   B. مَنْ هَذَا؟
   C. هَذِهِ أُمِّي
   D. هَذَا أَبِي

6. The cat is under the bed. Which position word is used? (1 mark)
   A. ʿalaa
   B. fawqa
   C. fii
   D. taHta

7. What does the Arabic sentence الْقِطَّةُ تَحْتَ السَّرِيرِ mean? (1 mark)
   A. The pen is in the bag.
   B. The book is on the table.
   C. The lamp is above the table.
   D. The cat is under the bed.

8. Which Arabic sentence means "Today is Thursday." (1 mark)
   A. أَلْعَبُ يَوْمَ السَّبْتِ
   B. أَذْهَبُ إِلَى الْمَدْرَسَةِ يَوْمَ الِاثْنَيْنِ
   C. الْيَوْمُ يَوْمُ الْخَمِيسِ
   D. فِي الْأُسْبُوعِ سَبْعَةُ أَيَّامٍ

9. How is the Arabic word غَدًا read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. ghadan
   B. yawm
   C. usbuuʿ
   D. madrasa

10. Which polite word means 'excuse me' when you want to speak? (1 mark)
   A. ʿafwan
   B. naʿam
   C. shukran
   D. laa

11. Which is a rule of good turn taking? (1 mark)
   A. Interrupt without saying anything
   B. Shout to be heard
   C. Wait until the speaker has finished
   D. Speak at the same time as others

12. What does the Arabic sentence آكُلُ الْخُبْزَ mean? (1 mark)
   A. I eat bread.
   B. I drink water.
   C. I like bananas.
   D. I like juice.

13. Which Arabic sentence means "I like bananas." (1 mark)
   A. أُحِبُّ الْمَوْزَ
   B. آكُلُ الْخُبْزَ
   C. أُحِبُّ الْعَصِيرَ
   D. أَشْرَبُ الْمَاءَ

14. What does the word wa mean in khubzan wa bayDan? (1 mark)
   A. with
   B. in
   C. and
   D. or

15. What does ilmis anfaka tell you to do? (1 mark)
   A. Close your eyes
   B. Touch your nose
   C. Open your mouth
   D. Raise your hand

16. How is the Arabic word أَغْمِضْ عَيْنَيْكَ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. ismaʿ
   B. uktub
   C. ilmis anfaka
   D. aghmiD ʿaynayka

17. What does the Arabic sentence كَيْفَ الْجَوُّ الْيَوْمَ؟ mean? (1 mark)
   A. The weather is cold.
   B. The weather is hot.
   C. The weather is rainy.
   D. How is the weather today?

18. Which Arabic sentence means "The weather is cold." (1 mark)
   A. الْجَوُّ مُمْطِرٌ
   B. الْجَوُّ بَارِدٌ
   C. الْجَوُّ حَارٌّ
   D. الْجَوُّ غَائِمٌ

19. In a short speech, what does the sentence anaa fii S-Saffi r-raabiʿ mean? (1 mark)
   A. I am in the kitchen
   B. I am at the door
   C. I am a teacher
   D. I am in Grade 4

20. What does the Arabic sentence أَنَا فِي الصَّفِّ الرَّابِعِ mean? (1 mark)
   A. I like my house.
   B. I am in Grade 4.
   C. Thank you for listening.
   D. In my house there is a kitchen.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Translate into English: al-jawwu ghaa'im (2 marks)

22. Translate into English: kulla ʿaamin wa-antum bi-khayr (2 marks)

23. Explain why you should copy sounds carefully when learning Arabic words. (2 marks) (2 marks)

24. Explain how a family celebration you know helps people to live together in peace. (3 marks) (3 marks)

25. Write four lines of a short conversation in which two friends greet each other and ask names. Use English letters for the Arabic. (4 marks) (4 marks)

26. Write the Arabic sounds and meanings of four position words. (4 marks) (4 marks)

27. Translate into English: ashummu bi-anfii (2 marks)

28. Translate into English: anaa tilmiidh (2 marks)

29. Translate into English: haadhaa baytii (2 marks)

30. Write an Arabic question and its answer that you could use to find out who a woman in a photograph is. Use English letters. (3 marks) (3 marks)

31. Translate into English: anaa araa biʿaynii (2 marks)

32. Translate into English: ʿindii akh wa ukht (2 marks)
pages.answers:
ARABIC LANGUAGE — TERMLY EXAM #1 (TERM 1) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — sabaahu l-khayr
   صَبَاحُ الْخَيْرِ is read sabaahu l-khayr and means good morning.

2. B — السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ
   السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ (as-salaamu ʿalaykum) means peace be upon you.

3. C — شُكْرًا
   شُكْرًا (shukran) means thank you.

4. B — ʿamm and khaal
   ʿamm is the father's brother and khaal is the mother's brother.

5. B — مَنْ هَذَا؟
   مَنْ هَذَا؟ (man haadhaa?) means: Who is this? (a boy or man)

6. D — taHta
   taHta means under.

7. D — The cat is under the bed.
   الْقِطَّةُ تَحْتَ السَّرِيرِ (al-qittatu taHta s-sariir) means: The cat is under the bed.

8. C — الْيَوْمُ يَوْمُ الْخَمِيسِ
   الْيَوْمُ يَوْمُ الْخَمِيسِ (al-yawmu yawmu l-khamiis) means: Today is Thursday.

9. A — ghadan
   غَدًا is read ghadan and means tomorrow.

10. A — ʿafwan
   ʿafwan is used to say 'excuse me' or 'pardon' before speaking.

11. C — Wait until the speaker has finished
   Good speakers wait for their turn and use polite words if they must interrupt.

12. A — I eat bread.
   آكُلُ الْخُبْزَ (aakulu l-khubza) means: I eat bread.

13. A — أُحِبُّ الْمَوْزَ
   أُحِبُّ الْمَوْزَ (uhibbu l-mawza) means: I like bananas.

14. C — and
   wa means 'and', so the phrase is 'bread and eggs'.

15. B — Touch your nose
   ilmis means touch and anfaka means your nose.

16. D — aghmiD ʿaynayka
   أَغْمِضْ عَيْنَيْكَ is read aghmiD ʿaynayka and means close your eyes.

17. D — How is the weather today?
   كَيْفَ الْجَوُّ الْيَوْمَ؟ (kayfa l-jawwu l-yawm?) means: How is the weather today?

18. B — الْجَوُّ بَارِدٌ
   الْجَوُّ بَارِدٌ (al-jawwu baarid) means: The weather is cold.

19. D — I am in Grade 4
   Saff means class and raabiʿ means fourth.

20. B — I am in Grade 4.
   أَنَا فِي الصَّفِّ الرَّابِعِ (anaa fii S-Saffi r-raabiʿ) means: I am in Grade 4.

SECTION B
----
21. (2 marks)
   Answer: The weather is cloudy.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

22. (2 marks)
   Answer: May you be well every year.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

23. (2 marks)
   Answer: A small change in a sound can change the meaning, and careful copying makes you clear to the listener.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for change of meaning and 1 mark for being understood.

24. (3 marks)
   Answer: People meet, share food and joy, sing and talk together, and learn to respect one another.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for meeting, 1 mark for sharing, 1 mark for respect.

25. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example: A: as-salaamu ʿalaykum. B: wa ʿalaykumu s-salaam. A: maa ismuka? B: ismii Ahmad.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct line: greeting, reply, question, answer.

26. (4 marks)
   Answer: fii (in), ʿalaa (on), taHta (under), fawqa (above).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with meaning.

27. (2 marks)
   Answer: I smell with my nose.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

28. (2 marks)
   Answer: I am a pupil (boy).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

29. (2 marks)
   Answer: This is my house.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

30. (3 marks)
   Answer: man haadhihi? haadhihi ummii. (Who is this? This is my mother.)
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the question, 1 mark for the answer, 1 mark for correct use of haadhihi for a woman.

31. (2 marks)
   Answer: I see with my eye.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

32. (2 marks)
   Answer: I have a brother and a sister.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.
